about: The introitus of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Night” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The Lord said to Me: You are My Son; this day I have begotten You. Why have the nations raged, and the peoples devised vain things? Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. The Lord said to Me: You are My Son; this day I have begotten You.
